official.deadline_note: Call opens 2 September 2026; studies must begin in August 2028 without exception.
official.application_cycle: 2026-2027 call (2 September 2026 to 15 January 2027) for studies beginning August 2028
official.status_note: CONVOCATORIA ABIERTA: open from 2 September 2026 to 15 January 2027, to start studies in August 2028 without exception.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Hasta $37,000 dólares por año escolar por hasta 18 meses para maestría, y hasta $25,000 por año escolar por hasta tres años para doctorado. Esta cantidad no está etiquetada por lo que el becario puede utilizar los fondos para manutención (según el tabulador del Departamento de Estado), colegiatura, cuotas y/o libros.
benefits: Up to USD 37,000 per school year for up to 18 months for master's, and up to USD 25,000 per school year for up to three years for doctorate; the amount is not earmarked, so the fellow can use the funds for living expenses (per the State Department rate table), tuition, fees and/or books.

Intensive English course in the United States of 3 to 9 months (start between January and March 2027), subject to approval and State Department budget; includes transfer, tuition, living expenses and visa.
Payment of standardized test fees once selected as Fulbright-García Robles fellows: TOEFL iBT up to USD 230 and GRE up to USD 249.

Admission application support of up to USD 400 for up to four universities for master's and up to USD 500 for up to five universities for doctorate, including advisory, with the Commission handling payment and tracking.
Fulbright medical expenses insurance (ASPE) and J-1 visa processing by the Commission; visa issuance is free of charge.
Doctoral fellows receive an additional USD 420 to cover the electronic application fee when transferring J-1 sponsorship to the host university once Fulbright-García Robles funding ends.
eligibility: Mexican nationality (the Fulbright-García Robles scholarship is granted to students with Mexican nationality).
Only candidates in Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) fields participate.

Only candidates who originate from and reside in the interior of the Republic, excluding Guadalajara and Monterrey; not eligible are those originating from and/or residing in Mexico City, Monterrey or Guadalajara and their conurbated areas (those who temporarily changed residence to study postgraduate studies in those cities are eligible).
Not already holding an admission from a university, and not holding a conditional acceptance letter that requires an English course at the US university that accepted them.

Not holding US residence or US nationality (including dual Mexican-US); not former Fulbright-García Robles master's or doctorate fellows; not living, working or studying in the United States; not seeking complementary support for studies already started in the US; not having resided in the US for more than one year in the five years prior to the close of the call; not having studied the bachelor's or master's in the US; employees and direct family members of the US State Department, SEP and SRE are not eligible.
requirements: Proof of birth or permanent residence in the states of the Republic established in the call (candidates may be born or reside in any city except Mexico City, Guadalajara and Monterrey and their conurbated zones).
Minimum average of 9 in the most recent complete degree from an accredited institution, documented with a letter from the university or the final certificate of grades.

Current and official results of TOEFL iBT (61 minimum and 79 maximum points; or on the new scale 3.5-4.0), or IELTS Academic (5.0 minimum and 6.5 maximum) or Duolingo English Test (95 minimum and 110 maximum); results have two-year validity.
Three recommendation letters, preferably in English (Spanish is also accepted for this programme), completed online in the corresponding section of the application.

Official transcript (tira de materias) for every degree obtained or in progress, signed and stamped by the university's School Records department; if the transcript does not include the average, a separate average letter is required; if studied at a university outside Mexico, an official document confirming conversion of the average to the Mexican scale is required.

Title, acta de titulación or commitment letter for all degrees obtained or in progress; the commitment letter must be in English, has no specific format, but must state that the candidate commits to obtaining the title by March 2028 at the latest.
documents: Completed online application with all required fields, submitted through solicitudes.comexus.org.mx
Evidence of Mexican nationality and of birth/permanent residence in the eligible interior states
University letter or final certificate of grades evidencing the minimum average of 9 in the most recent complete degree
Official and current TOEFL iBT, IELTS Academic or Duolingo English Test results

Official transcripts (tira de materias) for every degree obtained or in progress, signed and stamped by the university's School Records department, plus an average letter or foreign-grade conversion letter where applicable

Title, acta de titulación or English commitment letter to obtain the degree by March 2028; personal statement (ensayo personal), study objectives and CV in Spanish in PDF; for doctoral candidates, a sample of written work in Spanish of up to 10,000 words
selection_criteria: Only STEM candidates participate, from the interior of the Republic outside Mexico City, Monterrey and Guadalajara.
First-stage results are sent by email to the registered address; candidates who pass the initial filters move to the interview stage with a panel of experts in their study area.
Interviews are held via Zoom on the assigned dates and times; it is not possible to change the assigned interview date and time.
The results of the selection process are unappealable.
coverage: Up to USD 37,000 per school year for up to 18 months of master's study and up to USD 25,000 per school year for up to three years of doctoral study; the amount is not earmarked and may be used for living expenses (per the State Department rate table), tuition, fees and/or books.
Payment and tracking of admission applications at up to five universities, including advisory, up to USD 400 for up to four universities (master's) or USD 500 for up to five universities (doctorate).
Intensive English course in the United States of 3 to 9 months including transfer, tuition, living expenses and visa.
TOEFL iBT (up to USD 230) and GRE (up to USD 249) exam fees for selected fellows.
Fulbright medical expenses insurance (ASPE), J-1 visa processing at no cost, and a USD 420 extension-fee benefit for doctoral fellows.
application_method: Register for the online application at solicitudes.comexus.org.mx; registrations sent in previous calls cannot be reused as they are deleted from the system.
Submit the application once complete; clicking 'enviar solicitud' triggers an automatic COMEXUS email confirming receipt, and COMEXUS is not responsible if the candidate omits this step.
Apply directly to US universities; the Commission supports the admission process (payment and tracking) at up to five universities.
Complete the COMEXUS selection process for studies beginning August 2028: email notification of first-stage results, expert-panel interviews via Zoom, evaluations, and June 2027 notifications.
official.application_route: Single online application at solicitudes.comexus.org.mx during 2 September 2026 - 15 January 2027, with COMEXUS paying and tracking admission applications at up to five US universities.
official.study_mode: Full-time postgraduate study (master's or doctorate) at a US university, preceded by an intensive English course in the United States
official.citizenship_residency: Mexican nationality required; must originate from and reside in the interior of the Republic, excluding those originating from or residing in Mexico City, Monterrey or Guadalajara and their conurbated areas; US residence or nationality (including dual Mexican-US) is excluded
official.international_eligibility: Open only to Mexican nationals living in the interior of Mexico; applicants who live, work or study in the United States, hold US residence or nationality, or have resided in the US for more than one year in the five years before the call closes are excluded
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Only Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) disciplines are eligible
official.research_requirement: Doctoral candidates must submit a sample or example of written work in their specialization area or discipline, in Spanish, of up to 10,000 words
official.duration: Master's: up to 18 months. Doctorate: up to three years. Intensive English course: 3 to 9 months
official.description: The Beca Posgrado STEM Regional is the Fulbright-García Robles postgraduate call run by COMEXUS, the U.S.-Mexico Commission for Educational and Cultural Exchange, for Mexican nationals from the interior of the Republic who wish to study a master's or doctorate in STEM fields in the United States. The Commission supports the admission application process (payment and tracking) at up to five universities and provides an intensive English course in the US plus up to USD 37,000 per school year for master's or up to USD 25,000 per school year for doctorate. The call is open from 2 September 2026 to 15 January 2027 for studies beginning August 2028 without exception.
official.program_type: Fulbright-García Robles postgraduate scholarship (COMEXUS), master's or doctorate in the United States
official.english_requirement: Current official results of TOEFL iBT (61-79 points, new scale 3.5-4.0), IELTS Academic (5.0-6.5) or Duolingo English Test (95-110); results must be within two-year validity

verification.notes: Amounts (USD 37,000/school year master's up to 18 months; USD 25,000/school year doctorate up to three years), the 2 September 2026 - 15 January 2027 window, eligibility, requirements, benefits, key dates and notes were taken from the awarding body's own Beca Posgrado STEM Regional page on comexus.org.mx; the intensive-course structure and exam-fee support were cross-checked against the COMEXUS one-pager PDF; the J-1 two-year home-residency rule comes from the COMEXUS visa page. No aggregator or third-party value was used.

applicant_utility.summary: Screen yourself on geography first: this call is open only to Mexican nationals who were born and live outside Mexico City, Monterrey and Guadalajara and their metropolitan areas, so a CDMX address disqualifies you regardless of your CV. You file one online application at solicitudes.comexus.org.mx between 2 September 2026 and 15 January 2027, and COMEXUS then pays and tracks admission applications at up to five US universities, meaning you never front those application fees. The money is an unearmarked pot of up to USD 37,000 per school year (master's, 18 months) or USD 25,000 per school year (doctorate, three years) that you split between tuition, fees, books and living costs on the State Department table, so shortlist programmes where that ceiling realistically covers the total. Plan for a 3-9 month intensive English course in the US before an August 2028 start, and treat anything above the annual cap as your own expense, since this is partial funding, not a full ride.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Mexican STEM master's or doctoral applicants from the interior of Mexico with a 9-plus average and a current intermediate English score who need someone else to fund and manage the US university applications.
application_readiness_checklist: Verify origin and current residence (birth certificate or permanent-residence proof) fall outside CDMX, Monterrey and Guadalajara and their metropolitan areas; temporary relocation to those cities for postgraduate study is still allowed.

Book TOEFL iBT, IELTS Academic or Duolingo early enough that the score is inside the published band and less than two years old at submission (TOEFL iBT 61-79, IELTS 5.0-6.5, Duolingo 95-110); an expired or out-of-band score is a straight rejection.

Request official transcripts (tira de materias) signed and stamped by your university's School Records department for every degree obtained or in progress, plus a separate average letter if the transcript omits the average, and a conversion letter if any degree was studied outside Mexico.
Line up three recommendation letters and send the recommenders the form link immediately, since the letters are completed online rather than uploaded; Spanish is accepted for this call.
Draft the personal statement, study objectives and CV as Spanish PDFs, and if your intended field differs from your undergraduate degree, explain and justify the change explicitly inside the essays.

Collect title or acta de titulación for finished degrees, or an English commitment letter stating you will obtain the degree by March 2028 at the latest; doctoral applicants prepare a Spanish writing sample of at most 10,000 words.
Register fresh at solicitudes.comexus.org.mx because previous-call accounts are deleted, then click 'enviar solicitud' and keep the automatic confirmation email as proof of submission.
common_rejection_risks: Living or originating in Mexico City, Monterrey, Guadalajara or their metropolitan areas - automatic ineligibility no matter how strong the profile.
Already holding a US university admission, or a conditional acceptance that requires taking an English course at that university.
US residence or nationality, including dual Mexican-US status, or having lived, worked or studied in the United States.
Being a former Fulbright-García Robles master's or doctorate grantee, or having studied a bachelor's or master's in the US.
More than one year of US residence in the five years before the call closes.
An expired or out-of-band English score, or an average below 9 in the most recent complete degree.
Failing to press 'enviar solicitud' and receive the automatic confirmation email - COMEXUS accepts no responsibility for incomplete submissions.
Simultaneously holding an EducationUSA Opportunity Funds award, which is mutually exclusive with this scholarship and forces you to choose one.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Any cost above the annual cap: at private or high-cost US universities the unearmarked USD 37,000 or 25,000 per school year may fall short of tuition plus State Department-table living expenses, and dependent expenses and any travel beyond the transfer included in the funded English course stay with the applicant.
document_audit: Transcripts must be signed and stamped by the university's School Records department; a plain printout without the stamp, or one missing the average, needs an extra average letter and is the classic trap.
Degrees earned outside Mexico require an official host-university document converting the average to the Mexican scale.
English translations are not required at application; they only come into play if you become a finalist, so do not pay for translations now.
The graduation commitment letter must be written in English and explicitly commit to obtaining the degree by March 2028 at the latest.
Recommendation letters are filled in online inside the application rather than uploaded, so give recommenders several days of notice.
Do not attempt to reuse a registration from a previous call; the system deletes old records.
alerts: The published timeline is long and internally tight: the call closes 15 January 2027, notifications arrive in June 2027, the programme starts July 2027, yet studies cannot begin before August 2028 - confirm the actual start dates with becas@comexus.org.mx before planning around them.
Every Fulbright-García Robles fellow travels on a J-1 exchange-visitor visa, which blocks immigrant and work visas until two years of residence in Mexico are completed after the programme ends.
COMEXUS assigns your interview date and time and it cannot be changed; interviews run via Zoom with a panel of experts in your study area.

Doctoral fellows must transfer J-1 sponsorship to the host university once Fulbright-García Robles funding ends after up to three years; a USD 420 benefit covers the electronic extension application fee.
The two-year validity window on English tests means a score taken for another application in 2024 may already be expired by the January 2027 deadline.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: One complete online submission at solicitudes.comexus.org.mx (the file must be finished before you press submit, since only the automatic confirmation email proves it arrived), after which COMEXUS handles payment and tracking of the admission applications at up to five US universities and runs email screening plus a Zoom expert-panel interview to select the cohort.
